output.headline: AI's week: mathematical advances, efficiency, deployment, and safeguards

items.summary: OpenAI reports new results on long-standing problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, including work in geometry, cryptography, and complexity.
items.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science

items.summary: OpenAI describes how its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices support responsible AI governance in Europe as the EU AI Act advances.
items.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe

items.summary: The article presents a full-stack approach intended to make advanced AI more capable, affordable, and broadly useful.
items.title: Building abundant intelligence

items.summary: The case study describes how Univé combined leadership, responsible governance, and employee-led innovation with ChatGPT Enterprise to support workforce transformation.
items.title: Univé builds an AI-ready workforce

items.summary: OpenAI says it disrupted a Cambodia-based operation that used ChatGPT to support investment, romance, gambling, and impersonation scams.
items.title: Disrupting a Criminal Scam Operation

items.summary: The update covers lower GPT-5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra and describes how more efficient models can support enterprise AI workflows at scale.
items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6

items.summary: Anthropic published an investigation concerning three real-world incidents in its cybersecurity evaluations; the supplied publisher metadata does not describe the incidents or findings.
items.title: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations

items.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime

items.summary: The article says retaining reasoning and enabling compaction improved GPT-5.6 scores and efficiency on ARC-AGI-3.
items.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark

items.summary: OpenAI says it is providing 100,000 academic researchers with free access to advanced ChatGPT models to support research, collaboration, and discovery.
items.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers

items.summary: The article describes GPT-5.6 efficiency improvements across models, inference, and agentic workflows, with the goal of delivering more useful intelligence per dollar.
items.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency

items.summary: A field report describes scientists using AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing and accelerate software development and discovery in fields including genomics.
items.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI

items.summary: Claude Blog published an update about bringing MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude; the supplied publisher metadata provides no additional details.
items.title: Bringing MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude

output.limitations: This brief uses only supplied titles, publication metadata, and publisher summaries; it does not use article full text. The Anthropic cybersecurity evaluation item and the Claude MCP item had no publisher summary, so their descriptions are limited to what their titles establish.
output.overview: This week's feed spans advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science, efforts to improve GPT-5.6 price-performance and reasoning efficiency, and deployments in workforce development, retail support, academic research, and scientific computing. It also covers responsible AI governance in Europe, action against a criminal scam operation, cybersecurity evaluation incidents, and an update about bringing MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude.
